hero.title: SEO Consulting in Vienna for Sustainable Visibility
hero.description: Technical SEO, content, local SEO and GEO – analyzed, prioritized and implemented step by step, based on data.

situation.title: Why can't people find my website?
paragraphs: A website can work perfectly on a technical level and still barely be found on Google. Missing indexing, technical errors, unclear page structures, wrong keywords or missing content can all slow down visibility.
That's why SEO doesn't start with individual meta tags or blog posts, but with a structured assessment.
problems: Google Business Profile brings little visibility
There is no clear SEO strategy
situation.note: This is exactly where the SEO & GEO audit begins.

audit.title: What does the SEO & GEO audit check?
audit.description: The audit doesn't just look at individual errors, but at the technical, content and strategic starting point of the entire website.

categories.title: Technical SEO
categories.description: Can Google fully crawl, understand and index the website? This is where the problems that hold everything else back become visible.

categories.title: OnPage SEO
categories.description: Do content, structure and search intent align? We check whether every page has a clear job to do.

categories.title: Keywords & Competition
categories.description: Which search queries is the website relevant for today, and where is there untapped potential compared to the competition?

categories.title: Local SEO
categories.description: How visible is the business in local search queries in Vienna and the surrounding area?

categories.title: GEO / AI Visibility
categories.description: Is content prepared in a way that lets AI-based search and answer systems clearly attribute the business and its expertise?

categories.title: Tracking & Data
categories.description: Can what SEO actually achieves even be measured? Without clean data, every optimization stays a guess.

findings.title: Not a list of errors. Clear findings.
findings.description: An audit doesn't help much if all that's left afterward is a long list of technical errors. That's why the results are analyzed, consolidated and documented in a way that's easy to understand.

example.title: Important service pages aren't linked internally.
example.recommendation: Build internal links from relevant topic areas.

prioritization.title: Not everything needs to happen at once.
prioritization.description: All findings are prioritized by urgency, SEO impact and implementation effort. This creates a clear order instead of a messy to-do list.

tabs.label: Critical
tabs.description: Issues that affect crawling, indexing or technical accessibility.

tabs.label: High Impact

tabs.label: Growth

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about SEO and GEO. Here you'll find answers to the most common questions about our services.

items.question: How long does it take for SEO to work?
items.answer: SEO is a long-term process. Initial results are usually visible after 3 to 6 months, depending on competition, industry and starting point.

items.question: Can you guarantee position 1 on Google?
items.answer: No, a position 1 ranking cannot be guaranteed. SEO depends on many factors, including competition, industry, search volume and algorithm changes.

items.question: What does SEO cost?
items.answer: The cost of SEO depends on scope, competition and goals. Typically billed by monthly effort. After an analysis and an initial conversation, you'll receive a transparent quote.

items.question: Do I need ongoing SEO support?
items.answer: Yes, ongoing SEO support is recommended to continuously improve visibility and rankings and to be able to react to algorithm changes.

items.question: What is an SEO audit?
items.answer: An SEO audit is a comprehensive analysis of your website to identify strengths, weaknesses and optimization potential. It covers technical aspects, on-page and off-page factors as well as competitor analysis.

items.question: What is technical SEO?
items.answer: Technical SEO includes all measures that affect the technical foundation of a website in order to improve its visibility in search engines. This includes aspects such as page structure, load times, mobile optimization, indexing and crawling.

items.question: What is local SEO?
items.answer: Local SEO includes all measures aimed at increasing a business's visibility in local search results. This includes optimizing the Google Business Profile, consistent location data, local keywords and reviews.

items.question: What is GEO?
items.answer: GEO includes all measures aimed at increasing a business's visibility in generative AI search results. This includes optimizing content and sources for AI search systems as well as ensuring consistent location data.

items.question: What is the difference between SEO and Google Ads?
items.answer: SEO (search engine optimization) aims to increase a website's organic visibility in search results, while Google Ads are paid ads that appear above the search results. SEO is long-term and sustainable, Google Ads delivers immediate results but requires a budget.

items.question: Can an existing website be optimized?
items.answer: Yes, an existing website can be optimized. This includes technical improvements, on-page and off-page optimizations as well as adjusting content and keywords to improve visibility and ranking in search results.

faq.noteText: Didn't find your question? Send it to me – you'll get a clear answer, not a sales pitch.
